title: 「Reverse pseudo-cleft 反向偽分裂句」

source.file: Sentence Structure 233 - 「Reverse pseudo-cleft 反向偽分裂句」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 233; it is assigned system ID ss234 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formulas.formula: Focus + is / are / was / were + what + subject + verb

example: Trust was what the team lacked.
exampleZh: 信任，就是團隊所缺乏的。

examples.en: Trust was what the team lacked.
examples.zh: 信任，就是團隊所缺乏的。
examples.highlight: Trust was what the team lacked.

meaning.zh: 反向偽分裂句把焦點資料放在句首，然後以 be 動詞和 WH 子句補充說明。

rules.zh: 焦點成分必須放在句首 Target: Trust was what the team lacked. （信任，就是團隊所缺乏的。） 本練習不使用以下次序： What the team lacked was trust. （團隊所缺乏的，就是信任。） 後者是一般 WH-cleft／pseudo-cleft，並不是本練習的目標句型。
rules.en: Put the focus first. “Trust was what the team lacked” is the target reverse pseudo-cleft; the WH-first form belongs to the ordinary pseudo-cleft pattern.

rules.zh: 按意思選擇正確的 WH 詞 ● what：事物、行動或概念 ● where：地點 ● when：時間 ● why：原因 ● how：方法 ● who：人物 ● how long：時長 ● how much：數量、程度或價錢 ● how often：頻率
rules.en: Choose the WH-word according to meaning: what, where, when, why, how, who, how long, how much or how often.

rules.zh: 不要在 WH 子句內重複焦點成分 Correct: Trust was what the team lacked. Incorrect: Trust was what the team lacked it. what 已經代表所欠缺的事物，所以不可再加入 it。
rules.en: Do not repeat the focus inside the WH-clause: write “Trust was what the team lacked”, not “lacked it”.

rules.zh: 保留必要的介詞 A refund was what the customer asked for. （退款，就是顧客所要求的。） Ms Lee is who you should speak to. （李女士，就是你應該交談的人。） ask for 和 speak to 中的介詞不可刪去。
rules.en: Keep a necessary preposition, as in “A refund was what the customer asked for” and “Ms Lee is who you should speak to.”

rules.zh: 或 when 後不要加入多餘介詞 Correct: The library is where we meet. Incorrect: The library is where we meet at. Correct: Friday is when the course begins. Incorrect: Friday is when the course begins on. where 已包含地點意思，而 when 已包含時間意思。
rules.en: Do not add an unnecessary preposition after where or when because those words already carry place or time meaning.

rules.zh: 不要重複原因或方法標記 Correct: A power cut was why the lights went out. Incorrect: A power cut was why the lights went out because of it. Correct: Careful planning was how the team avoided delays. Incorrect: Careful planning was how the team avoided delays by it.
rules.en: Do not repeat because, by or the reason inside a why- or how-clause.

rules.zh: 按焦點的單複數及時間選擇 be 動詞 A clear map is what the visitors need. （訪客所需要的，就是一張清晰地圖。） Two more chairs are what the classroom needs. （課室所需要的，就是多兩張椅子。） A clear map was what the visitors requested. （訪客當時所要求的，就是一張清晰地圖。） The missing documents were what the auditor asked for. （核數師所要求的，就是那些遺漏的文件。）
rules.en: Match the form of be with the number and time of the focused information.

rules.zh: 把一段時間、價錢或頻率視為一個整體 Forty minutes is how long the journey takes. Three months was how long the repairs took. 雖然 minutes 和 months 是複數形式，但整段時間被視為一個完整的時長，因此通常使用單數 動詞。
rules.en: Treat a single measurement of time, price or frequency as one amount, so it normally takes singular be.

benefits.zh: 立即突出最重要的資料 The team lacked trust. Trust was what the team lacked. 第二句把 Trust 放在最前面，讀者一開始便知道句子的重點。
benefits.en: It makes the key point stand out immediately by putting the focus at the beginning.

benefits.zh: 清楚更正資料或作出對比 The blue jacket, not the black one, was what Amy chose. （艾米所選的，是藍色外套，而不是黑色那件。） 這個句型可以把正確答案或真正重點放在前面，特別適合澄清誤會或比較兩個選項。
benefits.en: It helps you correct or contrast information clearly and foreground the true choice or fact.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 學生經常使用一般的主語＋動詞＋賓語句式。反向偽分裂句提供另一種組織方法，避免多個句子 使用完全相同的開首。
benefits.en: It gives you more sentence variety beyond ordinary subject-verb-object order.

benefits.zh: 幫助組織解釋和口語答案 你可以先說出重點，再補充相關資料： ● Better communication is what the team needs. ● Monday is when the programme begins. ● A lack of time is why we changed the plan. 這些句型框架能幫助你在說話時更快整理答案。
benefits.en: It helps organise explanations and spoken answers by stating the focus before the supporting WH-clause.

benefits.zh: 適合在作文、報告和簡報中強調重點 當你希望讀者特別注意一個原因、方法、時間、地點或解決方案時，可以使用反向偽分裂句。 不過，這個句型帶有明顯的強調作用，因此不需要在每一句中使用。
benefits.en: It is useful for emphasis in essays, reports and presentations when highlighting a reason, method, time, place or solution.
